A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] '''scientist''' worked as a contractor for the corporation [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] on their [[re-engineering]] project during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She earned a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on her head for her efforts, which brought her to the attention of the [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|Findsman]] [[Vaskau Farg]]. The Findsman, who considered her a "[[Witch/Legends|witch]]," tracked her to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]], then to the secret [[Arkanian Microtechnologies installation]] where the experiments were conducted. There, he confronted her.
